Header: Botryodiploidea theobromae Sinhala - Pera murdu kunuweeme Rogaya; Tamil – Koiya men alukal noi

Prevention: Follow soil test based fertilizer application
Cover fruits with paper bags 3-4 weeks after fruit setting
Prune excess and damaged branches to facilitate aeration and sunlight
Monitoring: Observe soft rotten surface on fruits
Differentiate fruit fly damage with dark coloured puncture wounds and soft oozing
Maggots can be seen in fruit fly damaged fruits
Both fruit fly attack and soft rot symptoms can be observed in same fruit
Direct Control: Rate of dilution 30ml/ 10 lit. of water
Restrictions: Apply a fungicide once only at the initial stage of the fruit / before bagging fruits
Toxic to predatory mites, fish and earthworms
Toxic to parasitoids and fish and moderately toxic to predatory mites
